# Happy 2nd Birthday, Oliver!

This week, we celebrated the 2nd birthday of our sweet boy Oliver, Hamilton County’s first-ever Therapy Canine! 🥳

Oliver brings so much joy and comfort to our agency and the community at large, and we were truly humbled when Ivan, the owner at Pup Cup Heaven, reached out and asked to throw him a birthday party to thank him for his service.

Oliver not only had a pup cup….he had his cake and ate it too. 😏

Thank you, Sgt. Ryan Cornett and Oliver, for everything you do. We hope you all enjoy the pics!
